# Cinque

> Cinque® is an independent jewellery and object studio in London, founded by
> Cindy Liu. Pieces are individually made, cast and hallmarked in London, and
> treat jewellery as a form of memory archive.

## About

Cinque founder Cindy Liu, with backgrounds in architecture and metalsmithing,
practises jewellery and object making as a form of memory archive. Through wax
and metal forming, Cinque transforms natural and cultural relics into tangible,
wearable pieces. The name Cinque means "five", after the five fingers.

The studio is based in London, W2. Contact: cindy@cinque.studio

## What Cinque makes

- Rings, earrings, necklaces and cast metal objects
- Materials: sterling silver, 9ct gold, 18ct gold, platinum, gold vermeil, brass
- Finishes: polished, matte, brushed, oxidised, hammered
- Pieces are released in numbered drops and small or one-of-a-kind editions
- Bespoke commissions, including engagement rings, typically take 8-12 weeks
  from confirmation

All pieces are individually made, cast and hallmarked (silver and carat-gold
items) in London. Because they are handmade, each piece is unique and no exact
replicas are produced.

## Buying

- Prices are in GBP.
- Ships to the United Kingdom, United States, France, Germany and Ireland.
- In-stock pieces are typically dispatched within 3-5 working days.
  Made-to-order and commissioned pieces have longer, confirmed lead times.
- Orders outside the UK may attract import duties and taxes, payable by the
  recipient.
- Returns: under the UK Consumer Contracts Regulations an eligible order may be
  cancelled within 14 days of receipt for a refund. Items must be unworn and in
  original condition and packaging. Bespoke, commissioned, personalised or
  altered pieces are not eligible unless faulty. Return postage is the
  customer's responsibility unless the item is faulty.
